name: The Color of Blood
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Pays 40s instead of 60s. Gives 5,550 experience instead of 2,650, 2.09 times as much. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river.  My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy.  A mere 14 years old.  When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city.  He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up.  Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang.  For that Mac was stabbed in the back.

I want revenge.  Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas.  They are the color of blood.
narrative.objectives: Nikova Raskol of Stormwind wants you to collect 10 Red Wool Bandanas.
narrative.offerRewardText: So these bandanas -- filthy tokens of corruption -- are what my Mac had to die for?  Such a waste.  Such a tragic sacrifice.But alas, I cannot return to the past.  Just know, adventurer, that you have brought my family justice through your deeds.
narrative.requestItemsText: I see you are back, champion. Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?
